title: UK home sales rise against seasonal trend in November
summary:
UK estate agents agreed sales on 20,100 homes in the week ending 22 November, rising 1.1% against a historical average decline of 5.4% for this period. Net sales increased 4.2% despite fewer new listings, indicating stronger conversion rates in a challenging market.

title: Brighton council withdraws licensing scheme after challenge
summary:
Brighton & Hove City Council has withdrawn its proposed selective licensing designation for the Central Hove and Regency wards following judicial review proceedings. The scheme would have affected up to 7,274 privately rented properties across the two wards.

title: Literary heritage properties listed from £495k to £5.65m
summary:
Five properties with connections to notable authors have been listed for sale across England and Scotland, with prices ranging from £495,000 to £5.65 million. The listings include properties associated with Frances Hodgson Burnett, Daphne du Maurier, TS Eliot, Henry James and Rupert Brooke.

title: Landlord company formations jump 80% in five years
summary:
Landlords established 51,726 property companies during the 2025 to 2026 tax year, representing an 80% increase compared to five years earlier. The acceleration follows anticipated tax changes for individual landlords from April 2027, with Wigan, Lancaster and West Central London recording the fastest growth rates.

title: Scotland proposes two new council tax bands for £1m+ homes
summary:
The Scottish Government has introduced legislation to create two additional council tax bands for properties valued above £1 million, affecting approximately 13,600 homes. Industry representatives have criticised the proposals as adding complexity to an outdated system without addressing fundamental reform needs.

The post Scotland proposes two new council tax bands for £1m+ homes appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Landlord costs rise 43% in decade as sector faces pressure
summary:
The cost of providing rental homes in England and Wales increased by 43% between 2015 and 2025, outpacing general inflation by five percentage points. Mortgage interest accounted for 38% of landlord expenditure and over half of cost increases during the decade.

title: BestAgent introduces transparency standard amid listings dispute
summary:
Property comparison platform BestAgent has announced plans to implement a new transparency standard for estate agents across England and Wales on an opt-out basis. The 'BestAgent Baseline' will include requirements for honest pricing advice, material information disclosure, and referral fee transparency, whilst the platform maintains its current listings policy despite industry criticism.

title: First-time buyer age rises to 34 as rental costs climb
summary:
The average age of first-time buyers in England has increased to 34 as of 2025/26, up from 32 in 2019/20, according to the latest English Housing Survey. Private renters now spend 34% of their household income on housing costs, significantly higher than mortgagors at 20%.

title: Estate agents breach confidentiality with AI tools
summary:
Nearly half of estate agency staff are using unauthorised AI platforms and potentially breaching client confidentiality by inputting sensitive data into tools like ChatGPT. Research from Alto found 46% of professionals select their own AI platforms without guidance, whilst 69% now use AI regularly or daily.

title: Property software firm emphasises client accounting compliance
summary:
Property management software provider Veco is focusing attention on client accounting systems as agencies face increasing compliance pressures. The company, which serves more than 2,000 UK agency branches, says accurate client account balances simplify audits and reduce regulatory risks.
